chapter_note: Heavily damaged page (69.4%) but the surviving content is a continuous cosmological teaching about why the luminaries (sun, moon) and the redeeming powers do not fully rejoice — because they witness the enemy ruling and the living soul being abused, transferred body to body. The teaching closes with the eschatological binding of the enemy. This is substrate cosmology of the suffering Living Soul and the cosmic redeemers. Only the dialogue frame at i=3 is editorial overlay. The title (i=0-2) repeats the teaching premise but functions as an editorial label.
